The '''SWE/2 sonic rifle''' was a model of long-barreled [[sonic rifle]] produced by [[Telex-Delcor/Legends|Telex-Delcor]] and available for 1200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Part of a line of reliable and uncomplicated riot control equipment, the SWE/2 was one of the more unique weapons available from its maker, firing sound waves from a powerful [[acoustic generator]] in concentrated beams similar to the output of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Designed to be capable of taking down even the toughest of trouble-maker, the rifle's beam could not be parried by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], a feature of limited use in the SWE/2 but more of a selling point for its predecessor the [[SWE/1 sonic suppressor]] which was available during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Any being struck by the beam would find their fine motor centers shorted out, staggering them and impacting on their balance and hearing.<ref name="FH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SWE/2 sonic rifle was first mentioned in ''[[Far Horizons]]'', a reference book for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]] and written by [[Sam Stewart]].
